note: Roadmap built from the official trophy descriptions only: chapter and mission order from the story trophies, collectible counts from their descriptions, activities grouped by kind. Missable flags mean the trophy is tied to a story moment or strand that may close — chapter replay is not confirmed in the official descriptions, so treat them as missable until checked in the game.

stages.blurb: Play the story straight through: the opening mission, Chapters 1–4, the named story missions and the finale. Twelve trophies, all flagged missable — a mission trophy only pops while its mission is in front of you, so finish each one before moving on.
stages.title: Story first — Chapters 1–4 and the finale

stages.blurb: Stranger strands and the people of Leonida: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each end in a finale mission, plus eight full stranger strands and Bret's hunt. Do these while the story is still open — five of the six finales are flagged missable.
stages.title: Strangers and side strands

stages.blurb: Sweep the map: 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 100 vehicles, all 52 areas, 8 garages and 10 Scooter Bros registrations. Nothing here is missable, so this stage can run alongside the others — drive everywhere, pick everything up.
stages.title: Collectibles sweep

stages.blurb: The grind with numbers: 250 stunts, 42 gold Shooting Range medals, 14 drone-race wins, 20 race wins, 9 activity types, 18 meditation spots and 50 challenges — plus beating Cal at fishing and finishing one arcade game. Counters in the checklist track every one.
stages.title: Activities and challenges

stages.blurb: Crime with your partner: the 4-star escape, three back-to-back shop robberies, five Combat Focus takedowns, the VCIA departure, the Rhinos, the jewelry job, five bank vaults, one armored truck and one illegal operation per gang. Loud, fast, and all repeatable.
stages.title: Partner crime spree

stages.blurb: The last dozen: cocktails on Ocean Beach, the showroom smash, bowling, the partnership milestone, 500 choices, the second-try moment, the strange event, the melee drive-by, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent — then 100% completion, and the platinum lands on its own.
stages.title: Money, moments and the platinum
